truth_class: independent-third-party-implementation-output; not an ETSI-published test vector and not MBDSDR encoder output
scope: LDPC only: input is BCHFEC (kldpc=nbch unpacked bits); output is complete unshortened, unpunctured FECFRAME before bit interleaving. BCH generation is not validated.

bit_order.external_interface: one octet per bit, value 0 or 1, bit index equals stream index
bit_order.fixture_encoding: base64 of packed octets; bit i is (octet[i//8] >> (7-i%8)) & 1; no padding because all lengths are octet-aligned
bit_order.fecframe_layout: indices [0,kldpc) are systematic BCHFEC input; indices [kldpc,nldpc) are LDPC parity in stream order
bit_order.hash_order: unpacked_u8 hashes cover one byte per bit; packed_msb hashes cover the base64-decoded bytes

source.upstream_modifications: none; runtime stubs only replace GNU Radio scheduling/tag transport and contain no coding algorithm or address table
source.location_note: GPL source is under D:/mbdsdr/reference, outside the MBDSDR repository

self_check.normal_1_3_validation_regrouping: ETSI B.2 flat values regrouped as 20x12 + 40x3 for validation only; no value changed

random.generator: Python random.Random(seed); one getrandbits(8) per byte; MSB-first unpack
